verdict.rationale: Paper checks are a fair question for a banking-as-a-service product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions programmatic check issuance or check deposit with image capture. Bill pay, outbound payments and received debits are related money-movement features, not check support, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an ops user, checks still work — programmatic check issuance and check deposit with image capture, because real businesses still receive and send paper
